combatDetail.effect.empty_body.name: empty body
combatDetail.effect.empty_body.summary: Empty Body: invisible, and resistant to all damage except force, for a minute.
combatDetail.effect.sacred_weapon.name: sacred weapon
combatDetail.effect.sacred_weapon.summar: Sacred Weapon: the paladin's Charisma modifier is added to their weapon attack rolls, and the weapon sheds bright light, for a minute.
combatDetail.effect.blessed.name: blessed
combatDetail.effect.blessed.summary: Bless: +1d4 on attack rolls and saving throws.
combatDetail.effect.baned.name: baned
combatDetail.effect.baned.summary: Bane: -1d4 on attack rolls and saving throws.
combatDetail.effect.shield_of_faith.name: shield of faith
combatDetail.effect.shielded.name: shielded
combatDetail.effect.shielded.summary: Shield: +5 AC until the start of their next turn.
combatDetail.effect.mage_armor.name: mage armor
combatDetail.effect.mage_armor.summary: Mage Armor: base AC 13 + DEX while wearing no armor.
combatDetail.effect.barkskin.name: barkskin
combatDetail.effect.hasted.name: hasted
combatDetail.effect.hasted.summary: Haste: +2 AC, advantage on DEX saves, doubled speed, and one extra action each turn (one weapon attack, Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object).
combatDetail.effect.polymorphed.name: polymorphed
combatDetail.effect.polymorphed.summary: Polymorph: transformed into a beast; the form's stat block replaces their own (the server tracks it as a transformation), they cannot speak or cast, and damage past the form's hit points reverts them.
combatDetail.effect.slowed.name: slowed
combatDetail.effect.slowed.summary: Slow: -2 AC and DEX saves, speed halved, no reactions, and an action OR a bonus action each turn, not both.
combatDetail.effect.blade_ward.name: blade ward
combatDetail.effect.blade_ward.summary: Blade Ward: resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from weapon attacks until the end of their next turn.
combatDetail.effect.stoneskin.name: stoneskin
combatDetail.effect.stoneskin.summary: Stoneskin: resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
combatDetail.effect.blurred.name: blurred
combatDetail.effect.blurred.summary: Blur: attack rolls against them are made at disadvantage unless the attacker sees through illusions.
combatDetail.effect.faerie_fire.name: faerie fire
combatDetail.effect.faerie_fire.summary: Faerie Fire: attack rolls against them have advantage, and they cannot benefit from being invisible.
combatDetail.effect.guidance.name: guidance
combatDetail.effect.guidance.summary: Guidance: +1d4 on one ability check, then the spell ends.
combatDetail.effect.resistance_spell.sum: Resistance: +1d4 on one saving throw, then the spell ends.
combatDetail.effect.true_strike.name: true strike
combatDetail.effect.true_strike.summary: True Strike: advantage on their next attack roll against the target, then the spell ends.
combatDetail.effect.divine_favor.name: divine favor
combatDetail.effect.divine_favor.summary: Divine Favor: weapon attacks deal +1d4 radiant damage.
combatDetail.effect.hunters_mark.name: hunter's mark
combatDetail.effect.hunters_mark.summary: Hunter's Mark: +1d6 weapon damage against the marked quarry, and advantage on Perception and Survival checks to find it.
combatDetail.effect.hexed_caster.name: hexing
combatDetail.effect.hexed_caster.summary: Hex: attacks against the hexed target deal +1d6 necrotic damage, and it has disadvantage on checks with the chosen ability.
combatDetail.effect.enlarged.name: enlarged
combatDetail.effect.enlarged.summary: Enlarged: one size bigger, advantage on Strength checks and saves, and weapon attacks deal +1d4 damage.
combatDetail.effect.reduced.name: reduced
combatDetail.effect.reduced.summary: Reduced: one size smaller, disadvantage on Strength checks and saves, and weapon attacks deal -1d4 damage.
combatDetail.effect.branding_smite.name: branding smite
combatDetail.effect.branding_smite.summa: Branding Smite: the next weapon hit deals +2d6 radiant and makes the target visible (it cannot become invisible) until the spell ends; the charge is spent by the hit.
combatDetail.effect.guiding_bolt.name: guiding bolt
combatDetail.effect.guiding_bolt.summary: Guiding Bolt: the next attack roll against this creature has advantage, and that attack spends it (it fades as the caster's next turn starts).
combatDetail.effect.shocked.name: shocked
combatDetail.effect.shocked.summary: Shocking Grasp: the creature cannot take reactions until its next turn starts.
combatDetail.effect.ray_of_frost.name: ray of frost
combatDetail.effect.ray_of_frost.summary: Ray of Frost: the creature's speed is 10 feet lower until the caster's next turn starts.
combatDetail.effect.chill_touch.name: chill touch
combatDetail.effect.chill_touch.summary: Chill Touch: the creature cannot regain hit points until the caster's next turn starts, and an undead one has disadvantage on attack rolls against the caster until then.
combatDetail.effect.reckless.name: reckless
combatDetail.effect.reckless.summary: Reckless Attack: advantage on melee Strength weapon attacks this turn, and attack rolls against them have advantage until their next turn.
combatDetail.effect.frenzied.name: frenzied
combatDetail.effect.frenzied.summary: Frenzy: while the rage lasts, one melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of their turns (pc_attack bonusAttack 'frenzy'); one level of exhaustion when the rage ends.
combatDetail.effect.longstrider.name: longstrider
combatDetail.effect.stopped.name: stopped
combatDetail.effect.stopped.summary: Stopped: speed 0 for the rest of the turn (Sentinel's opportunity attack hit).
combatDetail.effect.hamstrung.name: hamstrung
combatDetail.effect.hamstrung.summary: Hamstrung: speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of the attacker's next turn (Slasher).
combatDetail.effect.shaken.name: shaken
combatDetail.effect.shaken.summary: Shaken: disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of the attacker's next turn (Slasher's critical hit).
combatDetail.effect.exposed.name: exposed
combatDetail.effect.exposed.summary: Exposed: attack rolls against them have advantage until the start of the attacker's next turn (Crusher's critical hit).
combatDetail.effect.protected.name: protected
combatDetail.effect.protected.summary: Protected: attack rolls against them are made at disadvantage until the start of their protector's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.heroism.name: heroism
combatDetail.effect.heroism.summary: Heroism: immune to being frightened, and they gain temporary hit points equal to the caster's spellcasting modifier at the start of each of their turns.
combatDetail.effect.mirror_image.name: mirror image
combatDetail.effect.mirror_image.summary: Mirror Image: three duplicates; an attack that would hit may strike a duplicate instead (d20: 6+ with three, 8+ with two, 11+ with one), destroying it.
combatDetail.effect.starry_form_archer.s: Starry Form (Archer): as a bonus action, a luminous arrow strikes one enemy: a ranged spell attack for 1d8 + WIS radiant (2d8 at druid level 10). Resolve it with pc_attack, weapon 'Starry Form: Archer'.
Starry Form (Chalice): whenever they cast a healing spell with a slot, they or a creature within 30 feet also regains 1d8 + WIS hit points.
combatDetail.effect.starry_form_dragon.s: Starry Form (Dragon): a concentration save or an Intelligence/Wisdom check treats a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
combatDetail.effect.absorb_elements.name: absorb elements
combatDetail.effect.absorb_elements.summ: Absorb Elements: resistance to the absorbed damage type (named in the condition) until the start of their next turn.
combatDetail.effect.absorbed_strike.name: absorbed strike
combatDetail.effect.absorbed_strike.summ: Absorb Elements: the first time they hit with a melee attack on their next turn, the target takes the extra dice of the absorbed type named in the condition, and the spell ends.
combatDetail.effect.armor_of_agathys.sum: Armor of Agathys: while its temporary hit points last, a creature that hits them with a melee attack takes 5 cold damage per slot level (apply with damage_enemy).
combatDetail.effect.gift_of_alacrity.sum: Gift of Alacrity: +1d8 on initiative rolls.
combatDetail.effect.zephyr_strike.name: zephyr strike
combatDetail.effect.zephyr_strike.summar: Zephyr Strike: their movement provokes no opportunity attacks; their next weapon attack has advantage and deals +1d8 force, then the charge is spent (the spell's speed burst rides that turn).
combatDetail.effect.kinetic_jaunt.name: kinetic jaunt
combatDetail.effect.kinetic_jaunt.summar: Kinetic Jaunt: +10 feet of speed, movement provokes no opportunity attacks, and they can move through other creatures' spaces.
combatDetail.effect.warding_wind.name: warding wind
combatDetail.effect.warding_wind.summary: Warding Wind: a 10-foot wind aura deafens those inside, is difficult terrain for others, and gives ranged weapon attacks into or out of it disadvantage.
combatDetail.effect.shadow_blade.name: shadow blade
combatDetail.effect.shadow_blade.summary: Shadow Blade: a conjured finesse blade dealing 2d8 psychic; attack with pc_attack, weapon 'Shadow Blade' (advantage against targets in dim light or darkness).
combatDetail.effect.crusaders_mantle.sum: Crusader's Mantle: their weapon attacks deal +1d4 radiant damage.
combatDetail.effect.elemental_weapon.sum: Elemental Weapon: the touched weapon is magical, +1 to attack rolls, and deals +1d4 of the chosen element.
combatDetail.effect.flame_arrows.name: flame arrows
combatDetail.effect.flame_arrows.summary: Flame Arrows: ammunition drawn from the quiver deals +1d6 fire damage on a hit (twelve pieces).
combatDetail.effect.spirit_shroud.name: spirit shroud
combatDetail.effect.spirit_shroud.summar: Spirit Shroud: their hits within 10 feet deal +1d8 radiant, necrotic, or cold damage; enemies starting their turn nearby lose 10 feet of speed and cannot regain hit points.
combatDetail.effect.thunderous_smite.sum: Thunderous Smite: the next weapon hit deals +2d6 thunder and forces a STR save or the target is pushed 10 feet and knocked prone; the charge is spent by the hit.
combatDetail.effect.wrathful_smite.name: wrathful smite
combatDetail.effect.wrathful_smite.summa: Wrathful Smite: the next weapon hit deals +1d6 psychic and forces a WIS save or the target is frightened; the charge is spent by the hit.
combatDetail.effect.searing_smite.name: searing smite
combatDetail.effect.searing_smite.summar: Searing Smite: the next weapon hit deals +1d6 fire and ignites the target (1d6 fire at the start of its turns, CON save ends); the charge is spent by the hit.
combatDetail.effect.blinding_smite.name: blinding smite
combatDetail.effect.blinding_smite.summa: Blinding Smite: the next weapon hit deals +3d8 radiant and forces a CON save or the target is blinded; the charge is spent by the hit.
combatDetail.effect.staggering_smite.sum: Staggering Smite: the next weapon hit deals +4d6 psychic and forces a WIS save or the target reels (disadvantage on attacks and checks, no reactions, for a turn); the charge is spent by the hit.
combatDetail.effect.banishing_smite.name: banishing smite
combatDetail.effect.banishing_smite.summ: Banishing Smite: the next weapon hit deals +5d10 force, banishing the target if that leaves it at 50 HP or fewer; the charge is spent by the hit.
combatDetail.effect.blazing_stride.name: blazing stride
combatDetail.effect.blazing_stride.summa: Blazing Stride: +20 feet of speed, no opportunity attacks against them, and creatures they pass within 5 feet of take 1d6 fire damage (once each per turn; apply with damage_enemy).
combatDetail.effect.aura_of_purity.name: aura of purity
combatDetail.effect.aura_of_purity.summa: Aura of Purity: resistance to poison damage, immunity to disease, and advantage on saves against blinding, charm, deafness, fright, paralysis, poison, and stunning.
combatDetail.effect.guardian_primal_beas: Guardian of Nature (Primal Beast): +10 feet of speed, 120-foot darkvision, advantage on Strength checks and saves, and attacks deal +1d6 force.
Guardian of Nature (Great Tree): advantage on Constitution saves and on Dexterity- and Wisdom-based attacks, and the ground within 15 feet is difficult terrain for enemies (the temporary hit points were granted at casting).
combatDetail.effect.shadow_of_moil.name: shadow of moil
combatDetail.effect.shadow_of_moil.summa: Shadow of Moil: resistance to radiant damage, attacks against them are at disadvantage, and a melee hit against them costs the attacker 2d8 necrotic (apply with damage_enemy).
combatDetail.effect.arcane_hand.name: arcane hand
combatDetail.effect.arcane_hand.summary: Arcane Hand: as a bonus action the hand strikes (Clenched Fist via pc_attack, weapon 'Arcane Hand', 4d8 force), shoves, grapples, or blocks.
combatDetail.effect.circle_of_power.name: circle of power
combatDetail.effect.circle_of_power.summ: Circle of Power: advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects, and a successful save for half damage means none instead.
combatDetail.effect.far_step.name: far step
combatDetail.effect.far_step.summary: Far Step: a bonus action teleports them up to 60 feet each turn.
combatDetail.effect.swift_quiver.name: swift quiver
combatDetail.effect.swift_quiver.summary: Swift Quiver: a bonus action makes two attacks with a weapon fed by the quiver (resolve each with pc_attack).
combatDetail.effect.holy_weapon.name: holy weapon
combatDetail.effect.holy_weapon.summary: Holy Weapon: the weapon is magical, sheds bright light, and deals +2d8 radiant on a hit; it can burst when the spell is ended early.
combatDetail.effect.intellect_fortress.s: Intellect Fortress: resistance to psychic damage and advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.
combatDetail.effect.platinum_shield.name: platinum shield
combatDetail.effect.platinum_shield.summ: Platinum Shield: half cover (+2 AC), resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and poison, and Evasion on Dexterity saves.
combatDetail.effect.primordial_ward.name: primordial ward
combatDetail.effect.primordial_ward.summ: Primordial Ward: resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage; a reaction can trade it all for one turn of immunity to a triggering type.
combatDetail.effect.otherworldly_guise.s: Otherworldly Guise: immune to two damage types (fire/poison or radiant/necrotic), immune to charm and fright, flying 40 feet, spellcasting modifier added to AC, and two attacks per Attack action.
combatDetail.effect.arcane_transformatio: Arcane Transformation: advantage on weapon attacks, +2d12 force on weapon hits, an extra attack per Attack action, no spellcasting, and a CON save against exhaustion when it ends (the 50 temporary hit points were granted at casting).
combatDetail.effect.crown_of_stars.name: crown of stars
combatDetail.effect.crown_of_stars.summa: Crown of Stars: seven motes; a bonus action hurls one (pc_attack, weapon 'Crown of Stars', 4d12 radiant). Track spent motes in the narration.
combatDetail.effect.blade_of_disaster.su: Blade of Disaster: a bonus action moves the rift-blade and makes two melee spell attacks (pc_attack, weapon 'Blade of Disaster', 4d12 force each; crits on 18+ and a crit triples the dice).
combatDetail.effect.sanctuary.name: sanctuary
combatDetail.effect.sanctuary.summary: Sanctuary: a creature targeting them with an attack or harmful spell must first succeed on a Wisdom save or lose the attempt and pick elsewhere. Ends if the warded creature attacks or casts a harmful spell.
Expeditious Retreat: they can Dash as a bonus action on each of their turns.
combatDetail.effect.flying.name: flying
combatDetail.effect.flying.summary: Flying: they can fly (the speed the granting effect states; 60 feet for the Fly spell). If the effect ends aloft, they fall.
combatDetail.effect.fighting_spirit.name: fighting spirit
combatDetail.effect.fighting_spirit.summ: Fighting Spirit: advantage on their weapon attack rolls this turn (the temporary hit points were granted when it was spent).
combatDetail.effect.giants_might.name: giant's might
combatDetail.effect.giants_might.summary: Giant's Might: Large, advantage on Strength checks and saves, and one weapon hit per turn deals +1d6 damage.
combatDetail.effect.bladesong.name: bladesong
combatDetail.effect.bladesong.summary: Bladesong: AC increased by their Intelligence modifier, +10 feet of speed, advantage on Acrobatics, and a bonus on concentration saves. Ends if they wear medium/heavy armor or a shield, or use two hands on a weapon.
combatDetail.effect.tentacle_of_the_deep: Tentacle of the Deep: a bonus-action spectral tentacle strike (pc_attack, weapon 'Tentacle of the Deep', 1d8 cold); a hit also halves the target's speed until its next turn.
combatDetail.effect.form_of_dread.name: form of dread
combatDetail.effect.form_of_dread.summar: Form of Dread: immune to being frightened, and once per turn a creature they hit must pass a WIS save or be frightened until their next turn (resolve via cast_at_enemy).
combatDetail.effect.spirit_totem_bear.su: Spirit Totem (Bear): allies in the 30-foot aura got temporary hit points when it rose and have advantage on Strength checks and saves while inside.
combatDetail.effect.spirit_totem_hawk.su: Spirit Totem (Hawk): the druid's reaction grants advantage on an attack against a creature in the aura; allies inside have advantage on Perception checks.
combatDetail.effect.spirit_totem_unicorn: Spirit Totem (Unicorn): allies have advantage on checks to detect creatures in the aura, and the druid's healing spells also heal aura allies for the spell's level.
combatDetail.effect.trance_of_order.name: trance of order
combatDetail.effect.trance_of_order.summ: Trance of Order: attacks against them cannot have advantage, and their own attacks, checks, and saves treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
combatDetail.effect.aspect_of_the_wyrm_f: Aspect of the Wyrm (Frighten): enemies starting their turn in the 10-foot aura must pass a WIS save or be frightened (resolve via cast_at_enemy).
combatDetail.effect.aspect_of_the_wyrm_w: Aspect of the Wyrm (Ward): allies in the 10-foot aura have resistance to the monk's chosen draconic damage type.
combatDetail.effect.protected_from_poiso: Protection from Poison: resistance to poison damage and advantage on saves against being poisoned; one poison afflicting them is neutralized.
combatDetail.effect.false_life.name: false life
combatDetail.effect.false_life.summary: False Life: bolstered by necromantic vigor (the temporary hit points were granted at casting).
combatDetail.effect.spiritual_weapon.sum: Spiritual Weapon: as a bonus action, the floating weapon strikes: a melee spell attack for 1d8 + spellcasting modifier force damage (+1d8 per two slot levels above 2nd). Resolve it with pc_attack, weapon 'Spiritual Weapon'.
combatDetail.effect.flame_blade.name: flame blade
combatDetail.effect.flame_blade.summary: Flame Blade: a fiery blade in the free hand; a melee spell attack for 3d6 fire (+1d6 per two slot levels above 2nd). Resolve it with pc_attack, weapon 'Flame Blade' (an action).
combatDetail.effect.aided.name: aided
combatDetail.effect.aided.summary: Aid: the hit point maximum and current hit points are higher by the amount in the name for 8 hours; they fall back when it ends.
combatDetail.effect.protected_from_evil_: Protection from Evil and Good: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead have disadvantage on attack rolls against them, and cannot charm, frighten or possess them.
combatDetail.effect.magic_weapon_1.name: magic weapon +1
combatDetail.effect.magic_weapon_1.summa: Magic Weapon: the weapon is magical, +1 to attack and damage rolls.
combatDetail.effect.magic_weapon_2.name: magic weapon +2
combatDetail.effect.magic_weapon_2.summa: Magic Weapon: the weapon is magical, +2 to attack and damage rolls.
combatDetail.effect.magic_weapon_3.name: magic weapon +3
combatDetail.effect.magic_weapon_3.summa: Magic Weapon: the weapon is magical, +3 to attack and damage rolls.
combatDetail.effect.death_ward.name: death ward
combatDetail.effect.death_ward.summary: Death Ward: the first time damage would drop them to 0 hit points they drop to 1 instead, and the spell ends; an effect that would kill outright without damage is negated.
combatDetail.effect.beacon_of_hope.name: beacon of hope
combatDetail.effect.beacon_of_hope.summa: Beacon of Hope: advantage on Wisdom saves and death saves, and healing restores its maximum.
combatDetail.effect.protection_from_ener: Protection from Energy: resistance to the damage type in the name.
combatDetail.effect.pass_without_trace.s: Pass without Trace: +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and they leave no tracks.
combatDetail.effect.warding_bond.name: warding bond
combatDetail.effect.warding_bond.summary: Warding Bond: +1 AC and saving throws and resistance to all damage while within 60 feet of the caster, who takes the same damage whenever they do.
combatDetail.effect.enhance_con.name: enhance ability (bear's endurance)
combatDetail.effect.enhance_con.summary: Enhance Ability (Bear's Endurance): advantage on Constitution checks (the temporary hit points were granted at casting).
combatDetail.effect.enhance_str.name: enhance ability (bull's strength)
combatDetail.effect.enhance_str.summary: Enhance Ability (Bull's Strength): advantage on Strength checks, carrying capacity doubled.
combatDetail.effect.enhance_dex.name: enhance ability (cat's grace)
combatDetail.effect.enhance_dex.summary: Enhance Ability (Cat's Grace): advantage on Dexterity checks, no damage from a fall of 20 feet or less.
combatDetail.effect.enhance_cha.name: enhance ability (eagle's splendor)
combatDetail.effect.enhance_cha.summary: Enhance Ability (Eagle's Splendor): advantage on Charisma checks.
combatDetail.effect.enhance_int.name: enhance ability (fox's cunning)
combatDetail.effect.enhance_int.summary: Enhance Ability (Fox's Cunning): advantage on Intelligence checks.
combatDetail.effect.enhance_wis.name: enhance ability (owl's wisdom)
combatDetail.effect.enhance_wis.summary: Enhance Ability (Owl's Wisdom): advantage on Wisdom checks.
combatDetail.effect.holy_aura.name: holy aura
combatDetail.effect.holy_aura.summary: Holy Aura: advantage on every saving throw, and attack rolls against them have disadvantage.
combatDetail.effect.fire_shield.name: fire shield
combatDetail.effect.fire_shield.summary: Fire Shield: resistance to the damage type in the name (the warm shield cold, the chill shield fire); a creature within 5 feet that hits them in melee takes 2d8 of the other type.
combatDetail.effect.spirit_guardians.sum: Spirit Guardians: a 15-foot aura; an enemy starting its turn inside saves (WIS) or takes 3d8 radiant, half on a success (the server rolls it), and its speed is halved there.
combatDetail.effect.confused.name: confused
combatDetail.effect.confused.summary: Confusion: no reactions; at the start of each turn a d10 decides what it does (1: wanders, 2 to 6: nothing, 7 to 8: attacks a random creature in reach, 9 to 10: acts normally).
combatDetail.effect.commanded.name: commanded
combatDetail.effect.commanded.summary: Command: it follows the one-word command on its next turn.
combatDetail.effect.banished.name: banished
combatDetail.effect.banished.summary: Banishment: gone to a harmless demiplane, incapacitated; it cannot be targeted and returns when the spell ends early.
combatDetail.effect.dancing.name: dancing
combatDetail.effect.dancing.summary: Irresistible Dance: dancing in place with all its movement, disadvantage on Dexterity saves and attack rolls, and attack rolls against it have advantage; its action buys a WIS save to stop.
combatDetail.effect.shillelagh.name: shillelagh
combatDetail.effect.shillelagh.summary: Shillelagh: their club or quarterstaff attacks with the spellcasting ability, deals a d8, and is magical.
combatDetail.effect.feather_fall.name: feather fall
combatDetail.effect.feather_fall.summary: Feather Fall: they descend 60 feet a round and take no falling damage.
combatDetail.effect.returned_4.name: returned from death (-4)
combatDetail.effect.returned_4.summary: Back from the dead: -4 to attack rolls and saving throws, one less after each long rest.
combatDetail.effect.returned_3.name: returned from death (-3)
combatDetail.effect.returned_3.summary: Back from the dead: -3 to attack rolls and saving throws, one less after each long rest.
combatDetail.effect.returned_2.name: returned from death (-2)
combatDetail.effect.returned_2.summary: Back from the dead: -2 to attack rolls and saving throws, one less after each long rest.
combatDetail.effect.returned_1.name: returned from death (-1)
combatDetail.effect.returned_1.summary: Back from the dead: -1 to attack rolls and saving throws; gone after the next long rest.
combatDetail.effect.cursed_str.name: cursed (str)
combatDetail.effect.cursed_str.summary: Bestow Curse: disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
combatDetail.effect.cursed_dex.name: cursed (dex)
combatDetail.effect.cursed_dex.summary: Bestow Curse: disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws.
combatDetail.effect.cursed_con.name: cursed (con)
combatDetail.effect.cursed_con.summary: Bestow Curse: disadvantage on Constitution checks and saving throws.
combatDetail.effect.cursed_int.name: cursed (int)
combatDetail.effect.cursed_int.summary: Bestow Curse: disadvantage on Intelligence checks and saving throws.
combatDetail.effect.cursed_wis.name: cursed (wis)
combatDetail.effect.cursed_wis.summary: Bestow Curse: disadvantage on Wisdom checks and saving throws.
combatDetail.effect.cursed_cha.name: cursed (cha)
combatDetail.effect.cursed_cha.summary: Bestow Curse: disadvantage on Charisma checks and saving throws.
combatDetail.effect.cursed_attacks.name: cursed (attacks)
combatDetail.effect.cursed_attacks.summa: Bestow Curse: disadvantage on attack rolls against the caster.
combatDetail.effect.cursed_will.name: cursed (will)
combatDetail.effect.cursed_will.summary: Bestow Curse: a WIS save at the start of each of its turns, or it does nothing that turn.
combatDetail.effect.cursed_necrotic.name: cursed (necrotic)
combatDetail.effect.cursed_necrotic.summ: Bestow Curse: the caster's attacks and spells deal 1d8 necrotic more to it.
combatDetail.effect.dazed.name: dazed
combatDetail.effect.dazed.summary: Bestow Curse: it wastes its action this turn.
combatDetail.effect.mocked.name: mocked
combatDetail.effect.mocked.summary: Vicious Mockery: disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
combatDetail.effect.searing_metal.name: searing metal
combatDetail.effect.searing_metal.summar: Heat Metal: it keeps hold of the red-hot object and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the caster's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.sickened.name: sickened
combatDetail.effect.sickened.summary: Eyebite (Sickened): disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks; a WIS save at the end of each of its turns ends it.
combatDetail.effect.halted.name: halted
combatDetail.effect.halted.summary: Command (Halt): it does not move and takes no action on its turn.
combatDetail.effect.retching.name: retching
combatDetail.effect.retching.summary: Stinking Cloud: it spends its action retching and reeling this turn.
combatDetail.effect.wandering.name: wandering
combatDetail.effect.wandering.summary: Confusion: it moves in a random direction and takes no action this turn.
combatDetail.effect.levitating.name: levitating
combatDetail.effect.levitating.summary: Levitate: it hangs in the air and can move only by pushing or pulling against something fixed; its speed is 0.
combatDetail.effect.suggested.name: suggested
combatDetail.effect.suggested.summary: Suggestion: it pursues the suggested course of action; damage from the caster or their companions ends it.
combatDetail.effect.enclosed.name: enclosed
combatDetail.effect.enclosed.summary: Resilient Sphere: sealed in a sphere of force; nothing passes in or out, so it can neither be harmed from outside nor harm anything outside.
combatDetail.effect.gaseous_form.name: gaseous form
combatDetail.effect.gaseous_form.summary: Gaseous Form: a misty cloud with a 10-foot fly speed, resistance to nonmagical damage and advantage on STR, DEX and CON saves; it cannot attack or cast spells.
combatDetail.effect.heroes_feast.name: heroes' feast
combatDetail.effect.heroes_feast.summary: Heroes' Feast: immune to poison and to being frightened, advantage on WIS saves, and 2d10 more hit points for 24 hours.
combatDetail.effect.dispel_evil_and_good: Dispel Evil and Good: celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead have disadvantage on attack rolls against them.
combatDetail.effect.enfeebled.name: enfeebled
combatDetail.effect.enfeebled.summary: Ray of Enfeeblement: its weapon attacks that use Strength deal half damage; a CON save at the end of each of its turns ends it.
combatDetail.effect.regenerating.name: regenerating
combatDetail.effect.regenerating.summary: Regenerate: 1 hit point back at the start of each of its turns.
combatDetail.effect.mind_blank.name: mind blank
combatDetail.effect.mind_blank.summary: Mind Blank: immune to psychic damage and to being charmed.
combatDetail.effect.foresight.name: foresight
combatDetail.effect.foresight.summary: Foresight: advantage on attack rolls, ability checks and saving throws, and attack rolls against them have disadvantage.
combatDetail.effect.acid_arrow_splash.su: Acid Arrow: the acid burns again at the end of its next turn.
combatDetail.effect.phantasmal_dread.sum: Phantasmal Killer: at the end of each of its turns it saves again or takes psychic damage.
combatDetail.effect.weird_dread.name: weird
combatDetail.effect.weird_dread.summary: Weird: at the end of each of its turns it saves again or takes psychic damage.
combatDetail.effect.hardening.name: flesh to stone
combatDetail.effect.hardening.summary: Flesh to Stone: it saves at the end of each of its turns; three failures turn it to stone, three successes free it.
combatDetail.effect.open_hand_reeling.su: Open Hand Technique: it cannot take reactions until the end of the monk's next turn.
Hurl Through Hell: gone through the lower planes until the end of the warlock's next turn; it returns to its space and, unless a fiend, takes 10d10 psychic damage.
combatDetail.effect.undead_dread.name: undead dread (chill touch)
combatDetail.effect.undead_dread.summary: Chill Touch: this undead has disadvantage on attack rolls against the caster until the end of the caster's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.poisoned_weapon.name: poisoned weapon
combatDetail.effect.poisoned_weapon.summ: Basic poison: the next creature their slashing or piercing weapon hits makes a DC 10 Constitution save or takes 1d4 poison damage.
combatDetail.effect.shrugged_off_presenc: It saw through the barbarian's Intimidating Presence and cannot be frightened by it again for 24 hours.
combatDetail.effect.squeezing.name: squeezing
combatDetail.effect.squeezing.summary: Squeezing through a space one size too small: its attack rolls and Dexterity saves are at disadvantage, and attack rolls against it have advantage.
combatDetail.effect.holy_nimbus.name: holy nimbus
combatDetail.effect.holy_nimbus.summary: Holy Nimbus: bright light for 30 feet; an enemy starting its turn in it takes 10 radiant damage, and the paladin has advantage on saves against spells cast by fiends or undead.
combatDetail.effect.camouflaged.name: camouflaged
combatDetail.effect.camouflaged.summary: Hide in Plain Sight: +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks while the ranger stays still against the surface they blend into.
combatDetail.effect.peerless_skill.name: peerless skill
combatDetail.effect.peerless_skill.summa: Peerless Skill: the bard's own Bardic Inspiration die rides their next ability check.
combatDetail.effect.quivering_palm.name: quivering palm
combatDetail.effect.quivering_palm.summa: Quivering Palm: the monk's vibrations wait in this creature; their action ends them with a CON save, 0 hit points on a failure.
combatDetail.effect.symbiotic_entity.sum: Symbiotic Entity: melee weapon hits deal +1d6 necrotic (the temporary hit points came with it) for 10 minutes.
combatDetail.effect.kensei_shot.name: kensei's shot
combatDetail.effect.kensei_shot.summary: Kensei's Shot: ranged weapon hits with a kensei weapon deal +1d4 this turn.
Sharpen the Blade: +1 to attack and damage rolls with a kensei weapon for a minute.
Sharpen the Blade: +2 to attack and damage rolls with a kensei weapon for a minute.
Sharpen the Blade: +3 to attack and damage rolls with a kensei weapon for a minute.
combatDetail.effect.agile_parry.name: agile parry
combatDetail.effect.agile_parry.summary: Agile Parry: +2 AC until the monk's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.defensive_flourish_1: Defensive Flourish: +1 AC until the bard's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.defensive_flourish_2: Defensive Flourish: +2 AC until the bard's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.defensive_flourish_3: Defensive Flourish: +3 AC until the bard's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.defensive_flourish_4: Defensive Flourish: +4 AC until the bard's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.defensive_flourish_5: Defensive Flourish: +5 AC until the bard's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.defensive_flourish_6: Defensive Flourish: +6 AC until the bard's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.defensive_flourish_7: Defensive Flourish: +7 AC until the bard's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.defensive_flourish_8: Defensive Flourish: +8 AC until the bard's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.defensive_flourish_9: Defensive Flourish: +9 AC until the bard's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.defensive_flourish_1: Defensive Flourish: +10 AC until the bard's next turn.
Defensive Flourish: +11 AC until the bard's next turn.
Defensive Flourish: +12 AC until the bard's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.awakened_astral_self: Awakened Astral Self: +2 AC, and a third arms strike with the Attack action (narrated).
combatDetail.effect.arms_of_the_astral_s: Arms of the Astral Self: spectral arms for 10 minutes; unarmed strikes reach 5 feet further and deal force damage.
combatDetail.effect.visage_of_the_astral: Visage of the Astral Self: darkvision to 120 feet and advantage on Insight and Intimidation checks for 10 minutes.
combatDetail.effect.shadow_step.name: shadow step
combatDetail.effect.shadow_step.summary: Shadow Step: advantage on the next melee attack this turn.
combatDetail.effect.drunkards_luck_attac: Drunkard's Luck: the next attack roll cancels its disadvantage (an advantage that the roll spends).
combatDetail.effect.drunkards_luck_check: Drunkard's Luck: the next ability check cancels its disadvantage.
Drunkard's Luck: the next saving throw cancels its disadvantage.
combatDetail.effect.giants_might_1d8.sum: Giant's Might: Large, advantage on Strength checks and saves, and one weapon hit per turn deals +1d8 damage.
combatDetail.effect.giants_might_1d10.su: Giant's Might: Large, advantage on Strength checks and saves, and one weapon hit per turn deals +1d10 damage.
combatDetail.effect.blessing_of_the_forg: Blessing of the Forge: the armor grants +1 AC until the cleric blesses something else.
Blessing of the Forge: the weapon is +1 to attack and damage rolls until the cleric blesses something else.
combatDetail.effect.blessing_of_the_tric: Blessing of the Trickster: advantage on Stealth checks for an hour.
combatDetail.effect.vigilant_blessing.su: Vigilant Blessing: advantage on the next initiative roll.
combatDetail.effect.elegant_maneuver.sum: Elegant Maneuver: advantage on the next Acrobatics or Athletics check this turn.
combatDetail.effect.corona_of_light.name: corona of light
combatDetail.effect.corona_of_light.summ: Corona of Light: bright light 60 feet around the cleric; enemies in it save at disadvantage against spells for a minute.
combatDetail.effect.unsettled_d6.name: unsettled (d6)
combatDetail.effect.unsettled_d6.summary: Unsettling Words: 1d6 comes off this creature's next saving throw.
combatDetail.effect.unsettled_d8.name: unsettled (d8)
combatDetail.effect.unsettled_d8.summary: Unsettling Words: 1d8 comes off this creature's next saving throw.
combatDetail.effect.unsettled_d10.name: unsettled (d10)
combatDetail.effect.unsettled_d10.summar: Unsettling Words: 1d10 comes off this creature's next saving throw.
combatDetail.effect.unsettled_d12.name: unsettled (d12)
combatDetail.effect.unsettled_d12.summar: Unsettling Words: 1d12 comes off this creature's next saving throw.
combatDetail.effect.hound_of_ill_omen.su: Hound of Ill Omen: a shadow hound hunts this creature; it saves at disadvantage against the sorcerer's spells.
combatDetail.effect.eldritch_strike.name: eldritch strike
combatDetail.effect.eldritch_strike.summ: Eldritch Strike: disadvantage on the next save against the fighter's spell before the end of their next turn.
combatDetail.effect.distracted.name: distracted
combatDetail.effect.distracted.summary: Distracted by a mage hand: the rogue who distracted it has advantage on attacks against it this turn.
combatDetail.effect.ancestral_protectors: Ancestral Protectors: disadvantage on attacks against anyone but the barbarian, whose allies resist its damage, until the barbarian's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.unwavering_mark.name: unwavering mark
combatDetail.effect.unwavering_mark.summ: Unwavering Mark: disadvantage on attacks against anyone but the cavalier until their next turn.
combatDetail.effect.thunder_gauntlets.su: Thunder Gauntlets: disadvantage on attacks against anyone but the armorer until their next turn.
combatDetail.effect.ambush_master_mark.s: Ambush Master: attack rolls against this creature have advantage until the scout's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.lit_by_perfected_arm: Perfected Armor: the next attack roll against this glowing creature has advantage.
combatDetail.effect.orders_wrath.name: order's wrath
combatDetail.effect.orders_wrath.summary: Order's Wrath: the next ally to hit this creature deals +2d8 psychic.
combatDetail.effect.planar_warrior.name: planar warrior
combatDetail.effect.planar_warrior.summa: Planar Warrior: the next weapon hit this turn deals +1d8 force.
combatDetail.effect.planar_warrior_2d8.s: Planar Warrior: the next weapon hit this turn deals +2d8 force.
combatDetail.effect.slayers_prey.name: slayer's prey
combatDetail.effect.slayers_prey.summary: Slayer's Prey: the first weapon hit each turn deals +1d6.
combatDetail.effect.umbral_form.name: umbral form
combatDetail.effect.umbral_form.summary: Umbral Form: resistance to all damage but force and radiant, and moving through creatures and objects, for a minute.
combatDetail.effect.otherworldly_wings.s: Otherworldly Wings: a flying speed of 30 feet.
combatDetail.effect.bulwark_of_force.sum: Bulwark of Force: half cover, +2 AC and +2 on Dexterity saves, for a minute.
combatDetail.effect.held_in_place.name: held in place
combatDetail.effect.held_in_place.summar: Held in place (Hold the Line): speed 0 for the rest of the turn.
Raging Storm (Tundra): speed halved until the barbarian's next turn.
combatDetail.effect.storm_aura.name: storm aura
combatDetail.effect.storm_aura.summary: Storm Aura: the raging Storm Herald's 10-foot aura (desert, sea or tundra).
combatDetail.effect.fanatical_focus_spen: Fanatical Focus is spent until this rage ends.
combatDetail.effect.elder_champion.name: elder champion
combatDetail.effect.elder_champion.summa: Elder Champion: 10 hit points at the start of each turn, and enemies within 10 feet save at disadvantage against the paladin.
combatDetail.effect.avenging_angel.name: avenging angel
combatDetail.effect.avenging_angel.summa: Avenging Angel: a 60-foot flying speed, and advantage on attacks against creatures the aura frightened.
combatDetail.effect.invincible_conqueror: Invincible Conqueror: resistance to all damage for a minute; the extra attack and the 19-20 critical are narrated.
combatDetail.effect.living_legend.name: living legend
combatDetail.effect.living_legend.summar: Living Legend: advantage on Charisma checks for a minute; the reroll and the turned save are narrated.
combatDetail.effect.mortal_bulwark.name: mortal bulwark
combatDetail.effect.mortal_bulwark.summa: Mortal Bulwark: truesight 120 feet and advantage on attacks against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends.
combatDetail.effect.exalted_champion.sum: Exalted Champion: resistance to nonmagical weapon damage and advantage on Wisdom saves for an hour.
combatDetail.effect.dread_lord.name: dread lord
combatDetail.effect.dread_lord.summary: Dread Lord: attack rolls against the oathbreaker are at disadvantage, enemies starting a turn within 30 feet take 4d10 psychic, and a bonus-action spectral strike (pc_attack weapon "Dread Lord's Shadows") deals 4d10 psychic.
combatDetail.effect.soul_trinket.name: soul trinket
combatDetail.effect.soul_trinket.summary: A soul trinket: advantage on Constitution saves and resistance to poison while it is held.
combatDetail.effect.adjusted_density_lig: Adjust Density (halved): +10 feet of speed, disadvantage on Strength checks and saves.
combatDetail.effect.adjusted_density_hea: Adjust Density (doubled): -10 feet of speed, advantage on Strength checks and saves.
combatDetail.effect.emissary_lapsed.name: emissary lapsed
combatDetail.effect.emissary_lapsed.summ: Emissary of Redemption is set aside until a long rest: the paladin attacked or harmed a creature.
Insightful Fighting: the rogue may Sneak Attack this creature without advantage for a minute.
combatDetail.effect.wildfire_spirit.name: wildfire spirit
combatDetail.effect.wildfire_spirit.summ: The wildfire spirit is out: the druid's fire and healing spells gain 1d8 (Enhanced Bond).
The Monster Slayer's prey: the ranger adds 1d6 to saves against its effects (Supernatural Defense).
combatDetail.effect.struck_as_it_fled.su: Relentless Avenger: the paladin's opportunity attack hit; they may move up to half their speed with use_reaction, drawing no opportunity attacks.
combatDetail.effect.cackle_fever.name: cackle fever
combatDetail.effect.cackle_fever.summary: Cackle Fever: a level of exhaustion no rest removes; great stress (a fight, damage) is a DC 13 CON save or 1d10 psychic and a minute of mad laughter; a DC 13 CON save after each long rest lowers the DC by 1d6, cured at 0.
combatDetail.effect.sewer_plague.name: sewer plague
combatDetail.effect.sewer_plague.summary: Sewer Plague: spent hit dice heal half, a long rest restores no hit points, and a DC 11 CON save after each long rest adds or removes a level of exhaustion; below 1 it is cured.
combatDetail.effect.sight_rot_1.name: sight rot (-1)
combatDetail.effect.sight_rot_1.summary: Sight Rot: -1 to attack rolls and to ability checks that rely on sight; 1 worse after each long rest, blinded at -5.
combatDetail.effect.sight_rot_2.name: sight rot (-2)
combatDetail.effect.sight_rot_2.summary: Sight Rot: -2 to attack rolls and to ability checks that rely on sight; 1 worse after each long rest, blinded at -5.
combatDetail.effect.sight_rot_3.name: sight rot (-3)
combatDetail.effect.sight_rot_3.summary: Sight Rot: -3 to attack rolls and to ability checks that rely on sight; 1 worse after each long rest, blinded at -5.
combatDetail.effect.sight_rot_4.name: sight rot (-4)
combatDetail.effect.sight_rot_4.summary: Sight Rot: -4 to attack rolls and to ability checks that rely on sight; 1 worse after each long rest, blinded at -5.
combatDetail.effect.sight_rot_5.name: sight rot (-5)
combatDetail.effect.sight_rot_5.summary: Sight Rot: -5 to attack rolls and to ability checks that rely on sight; 1 worse after each long rest, blinded at -5.
combatDetail.effect.hallucinating.name: hallucinating
combatDetail.effect.hallucinating.summar: Madness: vivid hallucinations, disadvantage on ability checks.
combatDetail.effect.paranoid.name: paranoid
combatDetail.effect.paranoid.summary: Madness: extreme paranoia, disadvantage on Wisdom and Charisma checks.
combatDetail.effect.tremors.name: tremors
combatDetail.effect.tremors.summary: Madness: uncontrollable tremors, disadvantage on attack rolls and on checks and saves that use Strength or Dexterity.
combatDetail.effect.babbling.name: babbling
combatDetail.effect.babbling.summary: Madness: babbling, incapable of normal speech or spellcasting.
combatDetail.effect.madness_attacks_near: Madness: must use their action each round to attack the nearest creature.
combatDetail.effect.madness_obeys.name: madness: obeys any order
combatDetail.effect.madness_obeys.summar: Madness: does whatever anyone tells them that is not obviously self-destructive.
combatDetail.effect.madness_hunger.name: madness: strange hunger
combatDetail.effect.madness_hunger.summa: Madness: an overpowering urge to eat something strange.
combatDetail.effect.madness_compulsion.s: Madness: compelled to repeat one activity over and over.
combatDetail.effect.madness_revulsion.su: Madness: intense revulsion toward something, as the antipathy effect of antipathy/sympathy.
combatDetail.effect.madness_delusion.sum: Madness: believes they are under the effects of a potion of the DM's choice.
Madness: disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks and saving throws while more than 30 feet from their lucky charm.
combatDetail.effect.madness_amnesia.name: madness: amnesia
combatDetail.effect.madness_amnesia.summ: Madness: partial amnesia, recognizes no one and remembers nothing from before.
combatDetail.effect.madness_confusion.su: Madness: whenever they take damage, a DC 15 Wisdom save or confused for 1 minute (the server rolls it).
combatDetail.effect.indefinite_madness.s: Indefinite madness: a new flaw, lasting until greater restoration or stronger magic.
combatDetail.effect.truth_serum.name: truth serum
combatDetail.effect.truth_serum.summary: Truth Serum: cannot knowingly speak a lie.
combatDetail.effect.recuperated.name: recuperated
combatDetail.effect.recuperated.summary: Recuperating: advantage on saving throws against a disease or poison for 24 hours.
combatDetail.effect.eyebright_ointment.s: Eyebright ointment on the eyes: sight rot does not worsen after the next long rest.
combatDetail.effect.blink.name: blink
combatDetail.effect.blink.summary: Blink: at the end of each of their turns the server rolls a d20; on 11 or higher they vanish to the Ethereal Plane until the start of their next turn.
combatDetail.effect.blinked.name: blinked
combatDetail.effect.blinked.summary: Blinked away: on the Ethereal Plane until the start of their next turn; nothing on the Material Plane can attack or target them.
combatDetail.effect.ethereal.name: ethereal
combatDetail.effect.ethereal.summary: Etherealness: on the Border Ethereal; they cannot affect or be affected by creatures on the Material Plane (no attacks either way).
combatDetail.effect.see_invisibility.sum: See Invisibility: they see invisible creatures as if they were visible.
combatDetail.effect.true_seeing.name: true seeing
combatDetail.effect.true_seeing.summary: True Seeing: truesight 120 feet: they see invisible creatures and into magical darkness.
combatDetail.effect.feebleminded.name: feebleminded

combatDetail.effect.mazed.summary: Maze: banished into a labyrinthine demiplane; it cannot be targeted, and its action buys an Intelligence check against DC 20 to escape (take_action escape).
combatDetail.effect.imprisoned.name: imprisoned
combatDetail.effect.imprisoned.summary: Imprisonment: bound by the spell until it is dispelled; it takes no actions and cannot be targeted.
combatDetail.effect.insane_contact.name: insane (contact other plane)
combatDetail.effect.insane_contact.summa: Insane (Contact Other Plane): no actions, no understanding of speech or writing, only gibberish, until a long rest.

combatDetail.effect.fleeing.name: fleeing

lineageUi.languageInfo:
A language you know is one you can speak, read and write. It decides who your character can talk to without help, and it comes up more than new players expect: half the trouble in a dungeon is written on a wall.

Common is the trade tongue everyone shares. The rest are the tongues of particular peoples: Dwarvish, Elvish, Orc, Draconic and so on. Pick whatever fits where your character grew up, or whoever you expect to be negotiating with.

gameHelp.ability_score.short: One of six numbers describing what your character is naturally good at.
gameHelp.ability_score.long: The six are Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma. Most scores land between 8 and 18 at first level. What actually gets added to your rolls is the modifier derived from the score: 10 or 11 gives +0, every 2 points above that adds +1, every 2 below subtracts 1.
gameHelp.modifier.short: The bonus or penalty an ability score adds to your rolls.
gameHelp.modifier.long: Work it out by subtracting 10 from the score and halving the result, rounding down. A score of 16 gives +3, a score of 8 gives -1. You will see modifiers written with a sign, like +3, everywhere on your sheet.
gameHelp.str.short: Raw physical power: hitting things with heavy weapons, shoving, climbing, lifting.
gameHelp.str.long: Most melee weapons use Strength for their attack and damage rolls. It also covers the Athletics skill, and the saving throw against being pushed or restrained.
gameHelp.dex.short: Agility and precision: light weapons, bows, armor class, dodging.
gameHelp.dex.long: Dexterity adds to your armor class in light and medium armor, decides your initiative, and powers finesse and ranged weapons. Its saving throw is the one you make to dodge fireballs and traps.
gameHelp.con.short: Toughness and stamina. It raises your hit points at every level.
gameHelp.con.long: You never roll a Constitution check, but its saving throw comes up constantly: resisting poison, surviving exhaustion, and holding concentration on a spell when you take damage.
gameHelp.int.short: Reasoning and recall. The casting ability for wizards.
gameHelp.int.long: It covers Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature and Religion. Its saving throw resists illusions and effects that attack the mind directly.
gameHelp.wis.short: Perceptiveness and judgement. The casting ability for clerics, druids and rangers.
gameHelp.wis.long: It covers Perception, Insight, Medicine, Survival and Animal Handling, and sets your passive Perception. Its saving throw resists charms, fear and mind control, which makes it one of the most valuable saves in the game.
gameHelp.cha.short: Force of personality. The casting ability for bards, sorcerers, warlocks and paladins.
gameHelp.cha.long: It covers Persuasion, Deception, Intimidation and Performance. Its saving throw resists banishment and possession.
gameHelp.armor_class.short: How hard you are to hit. An attacker must roll this number or higher to land a hit.
gameHelp.armor_class.long: Your AC comes from your armor, your shield, your Dexterity, and any magic or class feature that adds to it. The app works it out for you from what you are wearing. Higher is better, and most characters sit between 12 and 20.
gameHelp.hit_points.short: How much damage you can take before you drop.
gameHelp.hit_points.long: At 0 hit points you fall unconscious and start making death saving throws. Healing brings you back. Your maximum grows every level, based on your class's hit die and your Constitution modifier.
gameHelp.temp_hp.short: A buffer that soaks damage before your real hit points do.
gameHelp.temp_hp.long: They are not healing and do not stack: a new source replaces the old one rather than adding to it. They vanish on a long rest, and any left over when the effect ends are simply lost.
gameHelp.hit_dice.short: A pool of dice you spend during a short rest to heal yourself.
gameHelp.hit_dice.long: You have one per character level, of the size your class uses. Spend one on a short rest to roll it and regain that many hit points plus your Constitution modifier. You get half of them back on a long rest, so they are a resource to ration across a day of adventuring.
gameHelp.ability_check.short: A d20 roll plus a modifier, made when the outcome of something is uncertain.
gameHelp.ability_check.long: The DM sets a difficulty number and you try to meet or beat it. Climbing a wall is a Strength check, spotting an ambush is a Wisdom check. If you are proficient in a relevant skill you add your proficiency bonus too.
gameHelp.saving_throw.short: A d20 roll to resist something happening to you, rather than to make something happen.
gameHelp.saving_throw.long: A dragon breathes fire and you make a Dexterity save to take half damage. A vampire tries to charm you and you make a Wisdom save to shrug it off. Each class is proficient in two of the six saves, adding its proficiency bonus to those.
gameHelp.proficiency_bonus.short: A bonus you add to anything you are trained in. It grows from +2 to +6 as you level.
gameHelp.proficiency_bonus.long: It applies to attacks with weapons you are proficient with, skills you are proficient in, your two saving throw proficiencies, and your spell save DC. It is +2 at levels 1 to 4 and rises by 1 every four levels after that.
gameHelp.advantage.short: Roll two d20s and keep the higher one.
gameHelp.advantage.long: You get it when circumstances favour you: attacking an unaware enemy, or acting on information an ally gave you. Advantage and disadvantage cancel out exactly, no matter how many sources of each you have, and they never stack with themselves.
gameHelp.disadvantage.short: Roll two d20s and keep the lower one.
gameHelp.disadvantage.long: You get it when circumstances work against you: attacking at long range, fighting blind, or acting while poisoned or frightened. It cancels out with advantage exactly.
gameHelp.initiative.short: A Dexterity roll at the start of a fight that sets the turn order.
gameHelp.initiative.long: Everyone rolls once, and the round then runs from highest to lowest. The order holds until the fight ends.
gameHelp.action.short: The main thing you do on your turn: attack, cast a spell, dash, hide, help an ally.
gameHelp.action.long: Each turn you get one action, one bonus action, your movement, and one reaction that you can use before your next turn. Most turns are an action plus movement; bonus actions only exist when a feature or spell specifically grants one.
gameHelp.bonus_action.short: A quick extra thing on your turn, but only when something specifically grants one.
gameHelp.bonus_action.long: You cannot invent a bonus action: a class feature, a spell or a weapon has to say it uses one. You get at most one per turn, so features that compete for it force a real choice.
gameHelp.reaction.short: One response you can make between your turns, triggered by something specific.
gameHelp.reaction.long: The most common one is an opportunity attack when an enemy walks out of your reach. Spells like shield and features like Uncanny Dodge also use it. You get one and it comes back at the start of your turn.
gameHelp.attack_roll.short: A d20 plus your ability modifier and proficiency bonus, against the target's AC.
gameHelp.attack_roll.long: Meet or beat the AC and you hit, then roll the weapon or spell's damage. A natural 20 always hits and doubles the damage dice, and a natural 1 always misses.
gameHelp.critical_hit.short: A natural 20 on an attack roll. You roll all the damage dice twice.
gameHelp.critical_hit.long: Only the dice double, not the flat modifiers. Some features widen the range so a 19 counts too.
gameHelp.spell_slot.short: The fuel for casting a spell. You have a limited number of each level per day.
gameHelp.spell_slot.long: Casting a 1st-level spell spends a 1st-level slot or higher. Casting a spell with a bigger slot than it needs often makes it stronger, which is called upcasting. Most casters get their slots back on a long rest; warlocks get theirs back on a short one.
gameHelp.cantrip.short: A level 0 spell you can cast as often as you like, with no slot.
gameHelp.cantrip.long: Cantrips get stronger on their own at character levels 5, 11 and 17, which is why an attack cantrip stays useful all game.
gameHelp.spell_save_dc.short: The number an enemy must beat to resist your spell.
gameHelp.spell_save_dc.long: It is 8 plus your proficiency bonus plus your spellcasting ability modifier. The app calculates it for you and shows it on your sheet.
gameHelp.concentration.short: Some spells only last while you keep concentrating, and you can only concentrate on one at a time.
gameHelp.concentration.long: Casting a second concentration spell ends the first. Taking damage forces a Constitution saving throw against 10 or half the damage, whichever is higher, and failing it ends the spell. Being knocked unconscious ends it too.
gameHelp.ritual.short: A spell you can cast without spending a slot by taking 10 extra minutes over it.
gameHelp.ritual.long: Only spells marked as rituals can be cast this way, and only if your class supports ritual casting. It is free but far too slow for combat.
gameHelp.prepared_spells.short: Which spells you actually have available today.
gameHelp.prepared_spells.long: Some classes know a fixed short list forever, like bards and sorcerers. Others, like clerics and wizards, choose a fresh set after each long rest from a much bigger pool. Either way you can only cast what is on the list, and only while you have slots left.
gameHelp.short_rest.short: About an hour of downtime. You can spend Hit Dice to heal and recover some abilities.
gameHelp.short_rest.long: Features that say short rest come back, including warlock spell slots, monk ki, and a fighter's Second Wind and Action Surge. You can take several in a day.
gameHelp.long_rest.short: About eight hours of sleep. You regain all hit points and almost everything else.
gameHelp.long_rest.long: You get all your spell slots and long-rest features back and half your spent Hit Dice. You only benefit from one per 24 hours.
gameHelp.death_save.short: At 0 hit points you roll a d20 each turn to see whether you stabilize or die.
gameHelp.death_save.long: 10 or higher is a success, under 10 is a failure. Three successes and you stabilize; three failures and you die. A natural 20 puts you back up at 1 hit point, a natural 1 counts as two failures, and any healing at all wakes you immediately.
gameHelp.condition.short: A status effect that changes what you can do, like poisoned, frightened or stunned.
gameHelp.condition.long: Most conditions let you repeat a saving throw at the end of your turns to shake them off. The app tracks the ones you have and applies their effects to your rolls automatically.
gameHelp.exhaustion.short: A stacking penalty from six levels of increasing severity. Level 6 is death.
gameHelp.exhaustion.long: It comes from forced marches, going without sleep, and a few powerful abilities that trade stamina for effect. A long rest with food and drink removes one level.
gameHelp.attunement.short: A bond with a magic item, formed over a short rest. You can hold three at once.
gameHelp.attunement.long: Items that require attunement do nothing until you attune to them, so the three-slot limit is a real choice about which magic you carry.
gameHelp.difficult_terrain.short: Ground that costs double movement: rubble, deep snow, undergrowth, a crowd.
gameHelp.difficult_terrain.long: Moving 10 feet through it uses 20 feet of your speed. Some features let you ignore it.
gameHelp.cover.short: Something between you and an attacker makes you harder to hit.
gameHelp.cover.long: Half cover gives +2 AC and +2 on Dexterity saves, three-quarters cover gives +5, and total cover means you cannot be targeted directly at all.
gameHelp.opportunity_attack.short: A free swing when an enemy walks out of your reach.
gameHelp.opportunity_attack.long: It uses your reaction and happens as they leave. Taking the Disengage action avoids provoking it, which is why rogues get Disengage as a bonus action.
gameHelp.passive_perception.short: A standing score for what you notice without looking. 10 plus your Perception bonus.
gameHelp.passive_perception.long: The DM checks it against hidden things so nobody has to keep rolling. A higher passive Perception means traps and ambushes are spotted before they matter.
gameHelp.skill.short: A narrow area of expertise attached to an ability, like Stealth or Persuasion.
gameHelp.skill.long: Being proficient in a skill adds your proficiency bonus to checks that use it. You do not need proficiency to try, only to be reliably good at it.
gameHelp.expertise.short: Doubled proficiency bonus on a chosen skill, so you rarely fail at it.
gameHelp.expertise.long: Rogues and bards get it. On a skill you already have proficiency in, it makes you the party's clear specialist.
gameHelp.level.short: How experienced your character is, from 1 to 20. Higher levels bring more hit points, features and spells.
gameHelp.level.long: Levelling happens between sessions or at a milestone in the story. The app walks you through each choice a new level gives you.
gameHelp.subclass.short: A specialization within your class, chosen at level 1, 2 or 3 depending on the class.
gameHelp.subclass.long: Two fighters can play completely differently based on this one choice: a Battle Master spends dice on tactical maneuvers, an Eldritch Knight casts wizard spells. It is the biggest single decision about how your character plays.

closedHelp.condition.blinded.blurb: Cannot see. Fails any check that needs sight; attacks against it have advantage, its own attacks have disadvantage.

closedHelp.condition.charmed.blurb: Cannot attack the charmer or target them with harmful effects; the charmer has advantage on social checks against it.
closedHelp.condition.deafened.name: deafened
closedHelp.condition.deafened.blurb: Cannot hear. Fails any check that needs hearing.
closedHelp.condition.exhaustion.name: exhaustion
closedHelp.condition.exhaustion.blurb: Six worsening levels, from disadvantage on checks to death. Usually one level clears per long rest.
closedHelp.condition.frightened.name: frightened
closedHelp.condition.frightened.blurb: Disadvantage on checks and attacks while the source of fear is in sight, and cannot willingly move closer to it.
closedHelp.condition.grappled.name: grappled
closedHelp.condition.grappled.blurb: Speed becomes 0. Ends if the grappler is incapacitated or the two are forced apart.
closedHelp.condition.incapacitated.name: incapacitated
closedHelp.condition.invisible.name: invisible
closedHelp.condition.invisible.blurb: Cannot be seen without magic or a special sense. Attacks against it have disadvantage, its attacks have advantage.
closedHelp.condition.paralyzed.name: paralyzed
closedHelp.condition.paralyzed.blurb: Incapacitated and cannot move or speak. Auto-fails Strength and Dexterity saves; attacks against it have advantage and hit within 5 feet are critical.
closedHelp.condition.petrified.name: petrified
closedHelp.condition.petrified.blurb: Turned to stone: incapacitated, unaware, weighs ten times as much, resists all damage, immune to poison and disease.
closedHelp.condition.poisoned.name: poisoned
closedHelp.condition.poisoned.blurb: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
closedHelp.condition.prone.name: prone
closedHelp.condition.prone.blurb: Must crawl or spend half its movement to stand. Disadvantage on attacks; melee attacks against it have advantage, ranged ones disadvantage.
closedHelp.condition.restrained.name: restrained
closedHelp.condition.restrained.blurb: Speed 0. Attacks against it have advantage, its attacks have disadvantage, and it has disadvantage on Dexterity saves.
closedHelp.condition.stunned.name: stunned
closedHelp.condition.stunned.blurb: Incapacitated, cannot move, speaks falteringly. Auto-fails Strength and Dexterity saves; attacks against it have advantage.
closedHelp.condition.unconscious.name: unconscious
closedHelp.condition.unconscious.blurb: Incapacitated, unaware, drops what it holds and falls prone. Auto-fails Strength and Dexterity saves; attacks have advantage and hit within 5 feet are critical.
closedHelp.school.abjuration.name: abjuration
closedHelp.school.abjuration.blurb: Protection and banishment: wards, shields, dispelling, and sending things back where they came from.
closedHelp.school.conjuration.name: conjuration
closedHelp.school.conjuration.blurb: Bringing things into being or across distance: summoned creatures, conjured objects, teleportation.
closedHelp.school.divination.name: divination
closedHelp.school.divination.blurb: Knowing: seeing far, reading thoughts, finding what is hidden, glimpsing what is to come.
closedHelp.school.enchantment.name: enchantment
closedHelp.school.enchantment.blurb: Influencing minds: charm, fear, sleep, suggestion, and commands the target cannot refuse.
closedHelp.school.evocation.name: evocation
closedHelp.school.evocation.blurb: Raw energy: fire, lightning, cold and force, most of the blasting spells and the healing ones.
closedHelp.school.illusion.name: illusion
closedHelp.school.illusion.blurb: Deceiving the senses: images, sounds, disguises and phantasms that are not really there.
closedHelp.school.necromancy.name: necromancy
closedHelp.school.necromancy.blurb: Life and death: draining vitality, raising the dead, speaking with them, and undoing death.
closedHelp.school.transmutation.name: transmutation
closedHelp.school.transmutation.blurb: Changing what is: shape, size, substance or speed of creatures and things.
closedHelp.property.ammunition.name: ammunition
closedHelp.property.ammunition.blurb: Needs arrows, bolts or stones to attack at range; the ammunition is spent as it is fired.
closedHelp.property.double-headed.name: double-headed
closedHelp.property.double-headed.blurb: A weapon with a striking end at each side; the second end can make the extra light-weapon attack, doing the die in brackets.
closedHelp.property.finesse.name: finesse
closedHelp.property.finesse.blurb: Attack and damage may use Dexterity instead of Strength, whichever is better.
closedHelp.property.gunpowder.name: gunpowder
closedHelp.property.gunpowder.blurb: Fires with black powder, which it consumes along with the shot; wet or missing powder means it cannot fire.
closedHelp.property.heavy.name: heavy
closedHelp.property.heavy.blurb: Too big for Small creatures to use well: they attack with disadvantage.
closedHelp.property.light.name: light
closedHelp.property.light.blurb: Small enough to fight with one in each hand (two-weapon fighting).
closedHelp.property.loading.name: loading
closedHelp.property.loading.blurb: Slow to reload: only one shot per action, bonus action or reaction, however many attacks you have.
closedHelp.property.magazine.name: magazine
closedHelp.property.magazine.blurb: Holds the number of shots in brackets; once they are spent, an action reloads it.
closedHelp.property.reach.name: reach
closedHelp.property.reach.blurb: Strikes 5 feet further than usual, so 10 feet away instead of 5.
closedHelp.property.special.name: special
closedHelp.property.special.blurb: Has its own rules beyond the usual attack; the DM applies them when it is used.
closedHelp.property.thrown.name: thrown
closedHelp.property.thrown.blurb: Can be thrown to make a ranged attack, using the same ability as a melee swing with it.
closedHelp.property.two-handed.name: two-handed
closedHelp.property.two-handed.blurb: Needs both hands to attack with, so no shield or second weapon.
closedHelp.property.versatile.name: versatile
closedHelp.property.versatile.blurb: Usable in one hand or two; the two-handed grip does the larger damage die in brackets.
closedHelp.damage.acid.name: acid
closedHelp.damage.acid.blurb: Corrosive: sprays, oozes and dissolving breath.
closedHelp.damage.bludgeoning.name: bludgeoning
closedHelp.damage.bludgeoning.blurb: Blunt force: clubs, hammers, fists, falling.
closedHelp.damage.cold.name: cold
closedHelp.damage.cold.blurb: Freezing: ice breath, rays of frost, winter magic.
closedHelp.damage.fire.name: fire
closedHelp.damage.force.name: force
closedHelp.damage.force.blurb: Pure magical energy; almost nothing resists it (magic missile, eldritch blast).
closedHelp.damage.lightning.name: lightning
closedHelp.damage.lightning.blurb: Electricity: bolts, blue dragons, storm magic.
closedHelp.damage.necrotic.name: necrotic
closedHelp.damage.necrotic.blurb: Withering life force: undead touches, life drain, most death magic.
closedHelp.damage.piercing.name: piercing
closedHelp.damage.poison.name: poison
closedHelp.damage.poison.blurb: Venom and toxins: stings, poisoned blades, poison breath.
closedHelp.damage.psychic.name: psychic
closedHelp.damage.psychic.blurb: Mental assault: mind flayers, some enchantments, telepathic damage.
closedHelp.damage.radiant.name: radiant
closedHelp.damage.radiant.blurb: Holy light and searing brilliance: celestials, clerics' spells, the sun.
closedHelp.damage.slashing.name: slashing
closedHelp.damage.thunder.name: thunder
closedHelp.damage.thunder.blurb: Concussive sound: thunderwave, shatter, a giant's shout.
closedHelp.size.tiny.name: tiny
closedHelp.size.tiny.blurb: About the size of a cat or smaller; occupies a 2.5 foot square.
closedHelp.size.small.name: small
closedHelp.size.small.blurb: Halfling-sized; fills a 5 foot square but wields heavy weapons badly.
closedHelp.size.medium.name: medium
closedHelp.size.large.name: large
closedHelp.size.large.blurb: Horse or ogre sized; fills a 10 foot square.
closedHelp.size.huge.name: huge
closedHelp.size.huge.blurb: Giant or young dragon sized; fills a 15 foot square.
closedHelp.size.gargantuan.name: gargantuan
closedHelp.size.gargantuan.blurb: Ancient dragons, krakens; 20 feet or more on a side.

{help}
